final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM regional), kept AS (SELECT r.avg_amount, r.record_count, r.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_amount), AVG(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM kept
